newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Tech sued by option traders.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Tech sued by option traders.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc and its former chief executive, Emanuel Pinez, were named in a class action lawsuit filed Tuesday in the U. S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts, attorneys for the plaintiffs said.
They said the suit was filed on behalf of two classes of persons who traded options of Centennial.
Class I consists of all persons who either purchased call options or who sold put options during the period November 6, 1996, through February 25, 1997, and who suffered damages as a result.

Class II consists of all persons who sold put options at the same time as the purchase of put options by Pinez on Febebruary 7, 1997, and February 10, 1997, and who suffered damages thereby, or who purchased call options at the same time as the sale of call options by Pinez on February 7, 1997, and who suffered damages thereby.
With respect to Class I, the attorneys said, the complaint alleges that defendants Centennial and Pinez issued false and misleading financial statements in violation of the federal securities laws.
With respect to Class II, the complaint alleges that Pinez improperly traded in Centennial options on the dates mentioned based on inside information.
Plaintiffs are represented by several law firms including Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan PC and Harold B. Obstfeld PC, the firms said in a statement.
